validation_rules.R1: reply contains a parseable JSON object
validation_rules.R2: answerable/answer/evidence present with the right types
validation_rules.R5: answerable=true -> evidence occurs in the paragraph (final system: >= 90% character alignment)
validation_rules.R6: answerable=false -> answer empty ('not in the document' normalised to '')
validation_rules.R7: answerable=true -> answer is not a refusal phrase
validation_rules.R8: answer must not only repeat words of the question (ablation row D)

retry_policy: on failure the model sees its own error list and answers again; if still invalid the system abstains
confidence: added by the system: geometric-mean probability of the decision tokens (src/confidence.py)
